Hi! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer (it's Debian; the machine and everything on it are mine to work with, and I work for you).

A few things I can do, one line each:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each one needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
